global.name: Emperor
global.description: The supreme ruler of a worldwide empire.

global.name: High Regent
global.description: A supreme imperial guardian entrusted with authority beneath the emperor.

global.name: Overlord
global.description: A powerful ruler whose influence extends across many territories.

global.name: Viceroy
global.description: An imperial representative who governs vast territories on behalf of the emperor.

global.name: High Chancellor
global.description: A senior imperial official who oversees the affairs of the empire.

global.name: Chancellor
global.description: A trusted official who directs imperial administration and policy.

global.name: Proconsul
global.description: A senior governor entrusted with an important imperial province.

global.name: Consul
global.description: A distinguished official who exercises authority in the service of the empire.

global.name: Prefect
global.description: An administrator responsible for maintaining order across imperial territories.

global.name: Legate
global.description: An appointed representative entrusted with carrying imperial authority abroad.

global.name: Ambassador
global.description: A respected representative who builds influence among distant nations.

global.name: Emissary
global.description: A trusted agent sent on important missions beyond familiar borders.

global.name: Envoy
global.description: A representative establishing a presence in faraway lands.

global.name: Pioneer
global.description: An enterprising explorer who establishes a lasting foothold in new territories.

global.name: Pathfinder
global.description: A skilled traveler who charts routes through unfamiliar lands.

global.name: Trailblazer
global.description: An adventurous traveler who opens new paths for others to follow.

global.name: Explorer
global.description: A curious adventurer discovering the world beyond familiar surroundings.

global.name: Voyager
global.description: A traveler embarking on journeys to distant places.

global.name: Wayfarer
global.description: A traveler taking the first steps toward a wider world.

global.name: Citizen
global.description: A new participant beginning their journey on the world stage.

country.name: King
country.description: The sovereign ruler of a kingdom.

country.name: Prince
country.description: A member of a royal family or the ruler of a principality.

country.name: Duke
country.description: A high-ranking noble who traditionally rules a duchy.

country.name: Marquis
country.description: A noble traditionally entrusted with a border territory known as a march.

country.name: Count
country.description: A noble traditionally responsible for a county.

country.name: Viscount
country.description: A noble ranking below a count and above a baron, originally a count's deputy.

country.name: Baron
country.description: A noble who traditionally holds a barony under a monarch or greater lord.

country.name: Baronet
country.description: The holder of a hereditary title ranking below a baron and above most knights.

country.name: Knight
country.description: A person granted an honorary title for service, traditionally a mounted warrior.

country.name: Squire
country.description: An attendant to a knight, traditionally training for knighthood.

country.name: Burgess
country.description: A citizen of a borough or town, traditionally possessing civic rights and privileges.

country.name: Yeoman
country.description: A freeholder who traditionally owns and farms a small estate.

country.name: Crofter
country.description: A tenant farmer who works a small agricultural holding known as a croft.

country.name: Settler
country.description: A person who establishes a permanent home in a new place.

country.name: Wanderer
country.description: A traveler who roams from place to place without a fixed home or destination.

state.name: Lord Paramount
state.description: The supreme feudal lord holding ultimate authority over a state.

state.name: High Lord
state.description: A great lord ranking just beneath the lord paramount of a state.

state.name: Lord
state.description: A noble holding dominion over a domain within the state.

state.name: Earl
state.description: A high noble charged with governing a great territory of the state.

state.name: Thane
state.description: A lord who holds land directly from the crown in exchange for service.

state.name: Castellan
state.description: The keeper of a castle and the lands entrusted to its defense.

state.name: Warden
state.description: A sworn guardian responsible for keeping watch over part of the state.

state.name: Sheriff
state.description: The crown's officer charged with keeping order across the shire.

state.name: Freeholder
state.description: An owner of a freehold estate with an established stake in the state.

state.name: Tenant
state.description: An occupant holding land within the state.

suburb.name: Mayor
suburb.description: The civic leader of a local community.

suburb.name: Deputy Mayor
suburb.description: A civic official who supports the mayor and acts in their place when needed.

suburb.name: Councillor
suburb.description: A member of a local council who represents the community.

suburb.name: Steward
suburb.description: A trusted caretaker who looks after the interests of a local community.

suburb.name: Local
suburb.description: An established member of the local community.

suburb.name: Visitor
suburb.description: A traveler exploring the local area.
